page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.24xlarge is an accelerator-focused instance type within the Compute Optimized with GPU family. Built on KVM virtualization and the x86_64 architecture, it incorporates an Intel Xeon 8163 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz across 48 physical cores and 96 dedicated vCPUs with hyperthreading. Memory capacity totals 372.0 GB, providing 3.88 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is delivered via four NVIDIA Turing T4 GPUs totaling 64 GB of VRAM. The instance includes a 30 Gbps baseline network bandwidth allocation and provisions no local instance storage.

Benchmark profiles show a distinct division between single-threaded and parallel processing capabilities. In stress-ng testing, single-core execution registers at 1103.89, placing in the lower quartile, mirrored by single-threaded gzip compression at 19.2 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression at 7.56 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-threaded throughput demonstrates high scalability, with multi-core stress-ng scores reaching 70574.45 and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reaching 287.37 GB/sec. In-memory data throughput is also high, demonstrated by 64.27 million operations per second in redis SET tests and small-block cached read memory bandwidth of 3924.63 GB/sec. Uncached large-block read and write bandwidths measure 147.24 GB/sec and 58.43 GB/sec, respectively.

From a resource and efficiency standpoint, the instance balances dense CPU core counts with multiple energy-efficient inference GPUs. Workloads requiring fast single-thread clocks will encounter architectural limits given the 2.5 GHz base frequency and Skylake-era microarchitecture. However, the configuration is cost-efficient for parallelized GPU inference pipelines, machine learning serving, video transcoding, and concurrent data processing batches that scale horizontally across 96 vCPUs and four discrete T4 accelerators.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.24xlarge is a GPU-accelerated compute instance featuring 96 dedicated vCPUs across 48 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. It includes 372.0 GB of system memory, 30 Gbps baseline networking, and four NVIDIA Turing T4 GPUs providing 64 GB of aggregate VRAM, without local storage. Performance metrics highlight modest single-thread execution, as indicated by bottom-quartile stress-ng single-core and compression results, contrasted with top-tier multi-core scalability and high in-memory efficiency, where redis SET operations reach 64.27 million operations per second and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression achieves 287.37 GB/sec. Uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 147.24 GB/sec. This configuration offers balanced resource density for parallel inference, distributed machine learning workloads, video rendering, and concurrent compute tasks that leverage multi-GPU processing.
